\caption{\bt{\system\ architecture. Learning path (1--3): calculation chains of agent A's judged tasks are extracted into candidates and published after gates G1--G7. Use path (4--7): a lookup compares dependency versions; condition maintenance reuses verdicts keyed by condition identity and versions, runs only the remaining checks, and repairs failed definitions only with a unique filter that passes regression (G8). Execution path (8--9): a query that declares revisions is checked against the revisions' conditions on its own snapshot and executed on that snapshot. Dashed arrows are reads of database state.}{\system\ 架构。学习路径（1--3）：智能体 A 判题成功任务的计算链被提炼为候选，通过门槛 G1--G7 后发布。使用路径（4--7）：查找比较依赖版本；条件维护按条件身份与版本复用结论，只执行其余检查，并只用通过回归测试（G8）的唯一过滤修复失效定义。执行路径（8--9）：声明了修订的查询在自身快照上核对这些修订的条件，并在该快照上执行。虚线为读取数据库状态。}}
\label{fig:architecture}
\Description{Agents on top: agent A next to an LLM extractor, and agents B, C, and D on a shared line. The MAVRA middleware in the middle: admission with a candidate passing gates G1--G7, a store of versioned definitions whose rows list condition verdicts shared by condition identity, condition maintenance, bounded repair with gate G8, lookup, a version tracker, and snapshot-bound execution. PostgreSQL at the bottom as a storage slab of table pages, updated by ETL writers. Numbered arrows mark the learning, use, and execution paths; dashed arrows read database state.}
